chapter: Louis Jordan, Ink Spots and the union
title: Joining Louis Jordan in Las Vegas and the Bermuda trip
summary: Bunn worked about two years with Jordan after the war, joining him in Las Vegas from a lounge group.

bands.name: Louis Jordan and His Tympany Five

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: You worked with him for just, what, about a year?
I worked with him about two years.
What's the matter out there? Is that going on the tape, too?
No, I'll just tell them to be quiet. It's just some kids out front playing. They're not doing anything. The dogs are going crazy.
So you worked with him for about two years, then.
So he picked you up out here?
Yeah. I joined him out here. Las Vegas. Joined Louis in Las Vegas. Yeah.
Yeah, he came through and I joined him back there.
I had a little group out here, you know.
Then he took you with the tour. You went to Bermuda, right?
Yeah, I went to Bermuda. You heard all that, huh?
Yeah. We were talking the other day about that.

Yeah. These things come back to you. They're coming back to me, now. Which is wonderful. Things you can't remember, you mention things you know I've been [through], and naturally I own up to it because I remember it.
